title: 14 · O mapa de eixos
summary: Explains the 'eixos' concept: system-wide rules already violated once, with verdicts (violation/suspect/legitimate) mapped across the codebase.
notes: Manual override (orchestrator, ingest gate): retyped DOC->ADR, locked:true. The ten axes ARE the binding invariants of this codebase — money in integer centavos, access by permission key never role name, filter on the server, nothing hardcoded, vigência windows, etc. Three are enforced by custom ESLint rules; each axis was paid for by a real defect. These are locked constraints, not context.
